title: Hanford pairs nearly 35 billion treated gallons with nearly 700 tons removed cumulatively
publisher: U.S. Department of Energy Office of Environmental Management
summary: DOE reports nearly 35 billion gallons of groundwater treated and nearly 700 tons of contaminants removed over the program's life, alongside FY 2024's 2.3-billion-gallon annual result. Denominator: A sitewide lifetime cumulative volume and contaminant-mass pair, with the FY 2024 volume kept separate because the source does not provide an FY 2024 contaminant-mass value.
key_findings: Finding: DOE reports nearly 35 billion gallons of groundwater treated and nearly 700 tons of contaminants removed over the program's life, alongside FY 2024's 2.3-billion-gallon annual result.
